properties.name: app.embedding.api-key
properties.description: API key for the Gemini Developer API embedding endpoint.

properties.name: app.embedding.model
properties.description: Gemini Developer API model used to create embeddings.

properties.name: app.ingestion.enabled
properties.description: Whether daily reports are embedded and upserted into Qdrant at startup.

properties.name: app.ingestion.limit
properties.description: Maximum number of daily reports to embed at startup; zero imports all reports.
